decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 25 May 2007, the erection of a single storey side/rear infill extension with dimensions 2 metres wide, 6.5 metres long, and 3.35 to 4.1 metres high, returning a volume of 44.7cubic metres, giving a total volume increase to the original house of 64.2 cubic metres, as shown on drawing numbers DM07/1/1,  DM07/1/2,  DM07/1/3,  DM07/1/4, and DM07/1/5, received 2 April 2007 was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
Following the proposed extensions consisting of a single storey side/rear extension, the resulting building would fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1,Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a single storey side/rear infill extension to the house
